claims.claim: Texas suspended construction permits on 17 data-center projects and disabled the STEERS automatic-authorization portal after it kept issuing permits for a month following Governor Greg Abbott's September 2026 request to halt new permits.
claims.episode_span: Texas has suspended construction permits on 17 data-center projects and disabled the STEERS portal
claims.source_title: Texas has suspended 17 data center construction permits and shut down automated portal that rubber-stamped projects
claims.supporting_quote: Texas has suspended the construction permits of 17 data center projects and disabled a web portal that automated filing for new permits after it was discovered that they were still being issued a month after calls for the process to be paused.

claims.claim: FracTracker Alliance and Public Citizen documented more than two dozen permits issued after the pause request, and Sam Law said OpenAI and Amazon filings went through earlier in the week.
claims.episode_span: FracTracker Alliance and Public Citizen had already documented more than two dozen permits
claims.source_title: Texas has suspended 17 data center construction permits and shut down automated portal that rubber-stamped projects
claims.supporting_quote: watchdog groups FracTracker Alliance and Public Citizen both published reports detailing more than two dozen permits issued to Texas data center projects

claims.claim: All 17 suspended permits are stormwater construction authorizations, and Abbott had paused 1,800 data-center projects for an audit of power, water, and community impact.
claims.episode_span: All 17 suspended permits are stormwater construction authorizations
claims.source_title: Texas has suspended 17 data center construction permits and shut down automated portal that rubber-stamped projects
claims.supporting_quote: All 17 of the suspended permits are for stormwater construction, a process that sees construction companies raise and level the ground.

claims.claim: Abbott wrote that projects failing PUCT, ERCOT, and state-law requirements must be denied a Texas grid connection.
claims.episode_span: any project failing to comply with Public Utility Commission of Texas and ERCOT requirements
claims.source_title: Texas has suspended 17 data center construction permits and shut down automated portal that rubber-stamped projects
claims.supporting_quote: Any project that fails to comply with the requirements set forth by the PUCT and ERCOT, and by state law, must be denied connection to the Texas grid.

claims.claim: New York's year-long ban on data-center projects larger than 50 megawatts was signed by Governor Kathy Hochul in July as Senate Bill S10642, and in October 2026 President Trump mandated that AI data centers pay dividends to communities.
claims.episode_span: New York's year-long ban on data-center projects larger than 50 megawatts
claims.source_title: Texas has suspended 17 data center construction permits and shut down automated portal that rubber-stamped projects
claims.supporting_quote: The situation in Texas follows New York's year-long ban on data center projects larger than 50 megawatts that came into force earlier this year.

claims.claim: A Geekbench 7.1.0 listing scored the 256-core EPYC 9996 at 2,847 single-core points on a Dell PowerEdge R9815 running Linux, versus 2,444 for a Ryzen 7 9700X locked to 4.1 gigahertz, about 16.5 percent higher for the EPYC part.
claims.episode_span: scored 2,444 on the same Geekbench version, about 16.5 percent lower
claims.source_title: AMD EPYC 9996 Geekbench Listing Offers First Look at Zen 6 Single-Core Gains
claims.supporting_quote: scoring 2,847 points in single-core on a Dell PowerEdge R9815 server running Linux.

claims.claim: In that comparison Zen 6 led all 15 single-core subtests, with gains from 8.2 percent in File Compression to 25.7 percent in HTML5 Browser, on dense Zen 6c cores, and the listing was later pulled.
claims.episode_span: Zen 6 led all 15 single-core subtests in that comparison
claims.source_title: AMD EPYC 9996 Geekbench Listing Offers First Look at Zen 6 Single-Core Gains
claims.supporting_quote: Zen 6 came out ahead in all 15 single-core subtests, with gains ranging from 8.2% in File Compression to 25.7% in HTML5 Browser.

claims.supporting_quote: skilled technicians meticulously desolder the pricey flagship’s GB202 silicon and GDDR7 memory chips.

claims.source_title: Leaked video exposes how industrial-scale Chinese factories are dismantling RTX 5090s by the thousands to fuel AI servers
claims.supporting_quote: Nvidia has reportedly halted production of the GeForce RTX 5090 and is, in all likelihood, redirecting the valuable silicon to higher-margin professional GPUs like the RTX Pro 6000 Blackwell.
